SSC Stenographer Group C, D 2025 Final Result - Complete Details

Short Information : Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the final result for the post of Stenographer group C, D. This recruitment was released for 1590 posts. Applications for the SSC Stenographer C, D Recruitment 2025 were accepted from June 06, 2025, to June 26, 2025. The skill test examination was conducted on 28-29 January 2026. Candidates who qualified for this examination can download their SSC Stenographer Group C, D Final Result 2026 from the link given below..

  • Last Date : 26 June 2025

  • Exam Date : 06, 07, 08 August 2025
  • Exam City Details : 31 July 2025
  • Admit Card : 04 August 2025
  • Answer Key : 04 August 2025
  • Result : 28 November 2025
  • Final Answer Key/ Marks : 03 January 2026
  • Skill Test Date : 28-29 January 2026
  • Skill Test Exam City Details : 21 January 2026
  • Final Result : 18 June 2026
  • Revised FRTA Result/ Cutoff : 31 July 2026
  • Final Result : 25 August 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, Female : Rs. 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
